item.title: Abandoned child’s swing in communal garden, 31st July
item.description:
09:49 hours on 24/07/26 - Female neighbour at Flat 4 St Marks House, Phelp St SE17 cut the swing off of her child’s swing and moved it from the communal garden over the fence and into the communal green. This has been abandoned and constitutes flytipping under the Environmental Protection Act 1990 according to Southwark Council’s own signage which also states “Zero tolerance for flytipping. Flytipping and you will be fined. Don’t mess with Southwark.” I witnessed the neighbour abandon the swing and have video evidence. I expect Southwark Council’s to fine her and request the evidence I have or the signage is meaningless. The swing is also not there temporarily as she deliberately cut the swing off so nobody else could make use of it.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Phelp Street, Walworth, Greater London

item.title: Overgrown Weeds Outside Kent House Rail Station (Kings Hall Road Side), 31st July
item.description:
I would like to bring to your attention the condition of the area outside Kent House Rail Station, on the Kings Hall Road side. The weeds in the central areas and along the sides have become very overgrown and, as far as I am aware, have not been attended to for several months. The area is now looking untidy and would benefit from maintenance as soon as possible. I would be grateful if this could be inspected and the necessary work arranged at the earliest opportunity. Thank you for your attention to this matter.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kings Hall Road, Penge, Greater London
